blocks: the weakest identified narrator of the hadith's best chain, against a chain whose weakest is trustworthy (thiqa)
each further narrator of rank 7 or weaker (mastur, da'if, majhul …) in that chain beyond the first
each further name in the chain
each name of the chain not matched to a narrator of the Taqrib
each further chain the hadith has in the same book (mutaba'at within the book)
each further narration of the hadith found in another book (takhrij)
the chain ends with a Companion or a Successor (mawquf, maqtu')
the chain has a pair too far apart in time, or out of the order of generations
